raw_segments.text: Edgen, not know my voice. O times extremity, hast thou so cracked and
splitted my poor tongue in seven short years that here my only sun knows not my feeble
key of untunned cares. Though now this grained face of mine be hidden
sap-consuming winter's drizzled snow, and all the conduits of my blood froze up, yet
hath my night of life some memory, my wasting lamp some fading glimmer left, my dull deaf
ears a little used to hear. All these old witnesses, I cannot err, tell
me thou art my sun Antifolus.
